title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：truck　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 truck 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the driver ① drove the truck that no passenger in the station would have counted, and he said the driving was the whole of the day. The ② truck, meaning the lorry itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book; a truck, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ truck in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ truck at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A truck, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the driver said the counting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the truck was the whole of the matter, meaning the load and not the lorry. The ⑥ truck, meaning the load and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; truck, he said, is either something you drive or the only word that means both a lorry and a load. He said the load is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ truck had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ truck of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of counting; truck, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ truck I remember is the lorry counted in the timetable, which closed in 1982 and is still counted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ truck, my mother said in 1984, is the only lorry that improves by being counted; every truck, she said, is a load that has agreed to look like a lorry. She said the load was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卡车（指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆）
B. n. 卡车（指那辆卡车本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：drive the truck 开这一辆卡车
D. n. 卡车（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 卡车之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的卡车之事）
F. n. 卡车（指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一辆）
G. n. 卡车、载重（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 载重（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: drove the truck that no passenger in the station would have counted
The truck, meaning the lorry itself and not the ticket
the truck at the far platform
the truck was the whole of the matter
the truck had become a line in a timetable
The truck of the whole thing
A truck, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: drive the truck 意为“开这一辆卡车”，1975 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一辆卡车做了一遍。
truck 意为“卡车”，指那辆卡车本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。
truck 意为“卡车”，指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆，每一辆旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
truck 意为“卡车”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
truck 意为“卡车、载重”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这辆载重就是那件事的全部。
truck 意为“载重”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那辆卡车，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
truck 意为“卡车”，指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一辆，到 1980 年这一辆成了时刻表里的一行。
truck 意为“卡车之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的卡车之事是一处车站和三个日子的清点。
truck 意为“卡车”，我记得的是时刻表里清点过的那一辆，1982 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一辆。
truck 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，卡车是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的卡车。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年那位司机开了车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一辆卡车，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（drive the truck）
那辆卡车，指的是那辆卡车本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。（truck）
那处车站里每一辆卡车旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（truck）
最远那座站台那辆卡车，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（truck）
叔叔说这辆载重就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那辆卡车。（truck）
1984 年母亲说，卡车是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的卡车。（truck）
answers: In 1975 the driver drove the truck that no passenger in the station would have counted, and he said the driving was the whole of the day.
The truck, meaning the lorry itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book.
Every truck in that station had the same short ticket beside it.
The truck at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the truck was the whole of the matter, meaning the load and not the lorry.
A truck, my mother said in 1984, is the only lorry that improves by being counted.
